sents.en: We compute ordinal Krippendorff α \alpha across raters and Spearman ρ \rho between the mean rating for each output and its automatic score.

paragraphs.en: Text-crop Warp correlates more strongly with temporal ratings than full-frame Warp ( ρ = − 0.40 \rho=-0.40 vs. − 0.20 -0.20 ), supporting its use as the temporal primary. Text and temporal ratings show substantially higher inter-rater agreement than locality ( α = 0.87 \alpha=0.87 , 0.80 0.80 , and 0.37 0.37 ). The locality correlation is therefore interpreted cautiously. These results characterize alignment on the sampled outputs; broader validation would require more raters, scripts, and editing conditions.
paragraphs.zh: Text-crop Warp 与时间性评分的相关性高于全帧 Warp（ρ = −0.40 对 −0.20），支持将其用作时间性主指标。 文本与时间性评分的评分者间一致性显著高于定位性（α = 0.87、0.80 和 0.37）。 因此，定位性相关性被谨慎地加以解读。 这些结果刻画了在抽样输出上的对齐情况；更广泛的验证将需要更多评分者、脚本和剪辑条件。

paragraphs.en: The front exposes distinct operating points. FLUX-Text leads SeqAcc at the cost of large text-crop Warp; TextCtrl combines correctness and locality; RS-STE exchanges some correctness for lower Warp; and ViTeX-Edit-14B achieves the lowest comparable Warp. Wan2.1-VACE-14B remains non-dominated despite SeqAcc 0 0 , because stability and locality can be retained without rendering the target. Pareto membership must therefore be interpreted alongside the actual metric values.
paragraphs.zh: 前端暴露出不同的操作点。 FLUX-Text 以大幅文本裁剪 Warp 为代价在 SeqAcc 上领先；TextCtrl 兼顾了正确性与局部性；RS-STE 用部分正确性换取更低的 Warp；而 ViTeX-Edit-14B 在可比情况下取得了最低的 Warp。 Wan2.1-VACE-14B 尽管 SeqAcc 为 0 0，仍然是非被支配的，因为无需渲染目标即可保持稳定性与局部性。 因此，Pareto 成员身份必须结合实际指标数值来解读。

paragraphs.en: We complement the four framewise locality metrics with three probes of background motion, temporal feature stability, and face preservation. These diagnostics are reported separately from the 13 core metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个逐帧局部性指标之外，补充了背景运动、时序特征稳定性和人脸保持三项探针测试。 这些诊断结果与 13 个核心指标分开报告。

paragraphs.en: Low drift indicates stable adjacent-frame features. Natural motion can increase drift, while a consistently altered background can have low drift; source-referenced locality and BG-Warp provide complementary context.
paragraphs.zh: 低漂移表明相邻帧特征稳定。 自然运动可能增加漂移，而持续变化的背景可能具有低漂移；基于参考源的局部性和 BG-Warp 提供了互补的上下文。

paragraphs.en: Face preservation. RetinaFace [ 90 ] detects source faces in 131 of the 157 evaluation clips; detection overlays were spot-checked on sampled clips. On this subset, ArcFace-id [ 91 ] measures cosine similarity between source and output face embeddings. Source self-comparison gives 1.00 1.00 . The probe measures preservation of detectable faces and depends on visibility, detection, and source/output correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: 人脸保持度。 RetinaFace [90] 在 157 个评估片段中的 131 个里检测到了源人脸；检测结果的叠加图已在抽样片段上进行了抽查。 在该子集上，ArcFace-id [91] 度量源人脸与输出人脸嵌入之间的余弦相似度。 源人脸自比较得到 1.00 1.00。 该探针衡量可检测人脸的保持程度，并取决于可见性、检测结果以及源/输出的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: TextCtrl, RS-STE, and ViTeX-Edit-14B remain close to the Source anchor on background motion and feature drift. Face similarity separates them: ViTeX-Edit-14B scores 0.89 0.89 , below TextCtrl ( 0.99 0.99 ), RS-STE ( 0.97 0.97 ), and both FLUX-Text and Wan2.1-VACE-14B ( 0.96 0.96 ). Kling likewise combines relatively low feature drift ( 0.0044 0.0044 ) with lower source-face similarity ( 0.69 0.69 ). These contrasts show why temporal stability and source identity require distinct measurements.
paragraphs.zh: TextCtrl、RS-STE 和 ViTeX-Edit-14B 在背景运动与特征漂移上仍接近 Source 锚点。 人脸相似度则将它们区分开来：ViTeX-Edit-14B 得分为 0.89 0.89 ，低于 TextCtrl（ 0.99 0.99 ）、RS-STE（ 0.97 0.97 ）以及 FLUX-Text 和 Wan2.1-VACE-14B（ 0.96 0.96 ）。 Kling 同样结合了相对较低的特征漂移（ 0.0044 0.0044 ）与较低的源人脸相似度（ 0.69 0.69 ）。 这些对比说明了为什么时间稳定性与源身份需要不同的度量方式。

paragraphs.en: Cross-method associations with the core locality metrics are approximately | ρ | = 0.83 |\rho|=0.83 for BG-Warp, 0.65 0.65 for DINOv2 drift, and 0.93 0.93 – 0.98 0.98 for ArcFace-id. Background feature drift offers the least redundant signal in this comparison. The correlations indicate shared information on the evaluated methods while leaving room for complementary preservation diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 与核心局部性指标的跨方法关联性在 BG-Warp 上约为 |ρ|=0.83，DINOv2 漂移为 0.65，ArcFace-id 为 0.93–0.98。 在此比较中，背景特征漂移提供的信号冗余度最低。 这些相关性表明所评估的方法之间存在共享信息，同时仍为互补的保存诊断留有空间。
